description.value:
You've learned to fold your dual-wielding training into your spellcasting. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you use your action to cast a power that requires a weapon attack and you attack with a light weapon held in one hand, you can then use your bonus action to make an attack under the normal rules of Two-Weapon Fighting.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
